faqs.question: What is Little Learner Hub?
faqs.answer: Little Learner Hub helps childcare providers organize observations, lesson plans, child goals, forms, incident reports, and paperwork in one place so documentation takes minutes instead of hours.

faqs.question: Is there a free plan?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Free Plan includes a curated sample of high-quality lesson plans across Infant, Toddler, and Preschool that you can print, plus limited planning tools so you can explore Little Learner Hub before upgrading.

faqs.question: What is included in the Free Plan?
faqs.answer: Selected Free Lesson Plans (sample library), Print Free sample lesson plans, Browse & preview Pro lesson plans, About 30 days of calendar planning, Up to 20 favorites, 5 Child Profiles, 10 Observations Per Month, 6 Forms, 10 Document Creations, No Credit Card Required

faqs.question: What is included in the Pro Plan?
faqs.answer: The Pro Plan includes unlimited access to resources, downloads, child management features, and 250 document creations per month.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
faqs.answer: Yes. You may cancel your subscription at any time through your account settings.

faqs.question: Do I need to enter payment information for the Free Plan?
faqs.answer: No. The Free Plan is available without a paid subscription.

faqs.question: What Documentation Helpers are included?
faqs.answer: Observation Helper, Lesson Plan Helper, Daily Report Helper, Parent Newsletter Helper, Parent Handbook Helper, Contract Helper

faqs.question: How do I contact support?
faqs.answer: Visit the Contact Us page or submit a support request through the Help Center.
